notes.title: That’s right, it’s now released
notes.notes:
I'm afraid I won't be able to get up tomorrow morning. Recently, my dark circles are getting heavier and heavier recently.
I decided to let him show up in front of everyone before going to bed.
After all, I am not a large or well-known studio, and when the game is released, it will not affect or increase my income.

The update after the game is released will be updated after I wake up, that's it.
I am very happy and hope you all have a great time! ! ! !

notes.title: All achievements at this stage have been added
notes.notes:
There are a total of 18 game content achievements in the first stage, and you need to complete all the content in the first stage to complete.
The second stage will be updated within 2 days after the game goes live. It takes about 20 hours to pass the game.
Due to personal issues, I don’t currently have any income, so I need to find a job. During the time I haven't found a job, I will update as many new content as possible.
The later content has been designed in my own plan, and I hope you will understand.
All subsequent updates of the game are free, because personal technical ability reasons will not produce DLC, so the entire game is a one-time purchase for lifelong enjoyment.
Finally, the number of achievements in this game is 100.

notes.title: "Sword Story" will be officially launched at 9/27 10:00
notes.notes:
The online content this time is completely different from the beta version, and a lot of changes have been made to the content.
Some different changes have been added to the original normal mode.
First of all, thank you to those who have downloaded the demo version, whether you have entered the game or not, as long as you click the download button, you are supporting me.
This is my second game, and I can only be considered a novice for game development. But I still enthusiastically fantasize that my game will be loved by everyone (even if only one person says he likes to play my game).
Thank you very much!

notes.title: Making recipe
notes.notes:
At present, the production of the illustrated book has not been updated, it will take a little time.
Here are a few examples of recipes for the time being, in order to make it easier for everyone to collect the props they want according to their goals.
The order of the items cannot be wrong
Wood*3=Wooden sword (for the first time joining the club)
Bones*3=Skull
Cowhide*2+Pork=Pig Head
Bread + Egg + Bread = Sandwich
Egg*3=Poached egg
Bread + beef + vegetables = hamburger
Satin*3=commoner
Iron block*3=hammer
Iron block + wooden block + iron block = wooden shield
Iron block + stone block + iron block = iron shield
Tungsten steel block + iron block + tungsten steel block = steel helmet
Iron block + steel block + iron block = iron armor
Iron block + log + iron block = sickle
Venom + iron block + pine wood = poison arrow
Venom + red spar + colorful spar = poison dagger

notes.title: Test demo released on August 3
notes.notes:
Will open the beta version on August 3
The test version has a total of 5 levels, and the current content is only 10% of the total content.
Changes to the game will also change with the test version.
These things will take time to complete, and it will be a bit slow for me to make them by myself.
But I hope that friends who have played can provide valuable comments, and I will reply to you in time to make this game better.
In terms of art, it is a very, very difficult thing for individuals. If you are not good at learning art and have a low level of art skills, please bear with me.
  Currently only Simplified Chinese is available. For the English version, you need to wait for a later version update.
